sourceClaims.claim: Dashboard.svg directly establishes grouped vertical bar, grid, tooltip, series paint, and wide chart specimen geometry recorded in the source matrix
Stable identity, one-to-four series, keyboard behavior, legend toggles, semantic table, and responsive overflow are approved product decisions rather than SVG facts

evidence.source-integrity: pass: exact Dashboard.svg hash and source matrix classifications are checked
evidence.structural-contract: pass: public exports, SVG plot, native legend, tooltip, table, documentation and classified roots are asserted
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: hover, roving navigation, visibility, update and teardown execute in browser
evidence.accessibility: pass: plot naming, bounded Tab order, pressed states, tooltip equivalence and table headers execute without axe violations
evidence.focused-visual: pass: source-backed bar, grid, series paint, hover muting, tooltip and focus-visible styles are checked component-locally
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: reporting consumer owns period state and supplies prepared replacement data
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: long labels, category density, zero values and narrow local overflow remain contained

staticVisual: pass: grouped one-to-four-series and narrow fixtures use production markup
realInteractionVisual: pass: real hover and keyboard focus activate source-backed muting, tooltip and focus paint
runtimeBehavior: pass: arrows, Home/End, legend toggles, table disclosure, update and teardown execute

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: pointer hover, Tab/focus-visible, arrow navigation, legend activation, table disclosure and narrow overflow inspected

findings.description: Zero values retain zero-height paint and use a transparent 12-unit SVG hit and focus target; this interaction geometry is a repository implementation decision, not a source token.
Pointer departure dismisses hover inspection when legend focus is present while preserving tooltip ownership by a focused chart datum.

knownLimitations: source includes eight-series specimens while the approved reusable product contract intentionally supports one through four
source does not establish keyboard, persistent legend, accessible table, or responsive behavior
